RagShortTexts: Gebicca’s standing rests on success, reliability and shares.
Roman friendship does not replace local consent to service.

Variants.Content: Standing comes from success, reliability and distribution. Roman friendship strengthens bargaining without making every chief accept the same service promise.

Gebicca’s standing rests on success, reliability and shares. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Roman friendship does not replace local consent to service.

Roman friendship does not replace local consent to service. Nominal rights require local execution, with consent and supply both shaping authority. Gebicca’s standing rests on success, reliability and shares.

Gebicca’s standing rests on success, reliability and shares. Households judge rule through protected families, land and responses to appeals. Roman friendship does not replace local consent to service.

Roman friendship does not replace local consent to service. Arbitration and delivered promises support trading credit; distant prestige still needs local response. Gebicca’s standing rests on success, reliability and shares.
